news.title: Consumer prices rose 0.1% in July, as expected, putting the annual rate at 3.4%
news.summary: The consumer price index was expected to increase 0.1% in July, with an annual rate of 3.4%. The Consumer Price Index is a measure of inflation in the United States.

news.title: Mortgage rates finally stop rising, causing demand to trickle back
news.summary: Mortgage rates finally eased a tiny bit, but it was enough to bring some demand back to a very beleaguered mortgage market.

news.title: Google’s new Pixel 11 puts Gemini at center of AI phone battle with Apple
news.summary: Google is launching the Pixel 11 lineup weeks before Apple rolls out a rebuilt Siri powered by Gemini AI models. Apple is also rolling out a new Siri with a new set of AI features.

news.title: Trust, but hedge: Quietly violent summer lingers as bulls buy crash protection
news.summary: It's been a wild summer for stocks, even if it may not feel like it at surface level. Stocks have been on the up and down this year, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average up more than 10% this year.

news.title: Houthi attack kills six in first fatalities in Red Sea in over a year; U.S. strikes container ship
news.summary: A cargoship and containership have been hit in the Red Sea and Gulf of Oman as the war inflicts a toll on the world's critical shipping lanes.

news.title: Citadel Securities called the stock-market reset. Now it sees a leverage buildup on the horizon.
news.summary: Strategist Scott Rubner says a growing list of stock-market buyers are pushing it in a positive direction. Rubner: Big hedge funds and institutional managers.

news.title: CoreWeave’s stock is rocketing after earnings lead to praise from bulls and bears alike
news.summary: CoreWeave is broadening its customer base and benefiting from upbeat pricing dynamics, analysts say. CoreWeave: We're broadening our customer base, benefiting from positive pricing dynamics.

news.title: Nebius adds to the excitement around neocloud stocks with upbeat earnings of its own
news.summary: Investors are reacting positively to earnings results and demand signals from neocloud companies CoreWeave and Nebius. The companies are expected to report results in the next few days.

news.title: Eli Lilly is suing pharmacies and peptide vendors over sale of its next big weight-loss drug: retatrutide
news.summary: Some Americans have turned to medical spas and pharmacies that sell peptides for health and wellness benefits for access to compounded versions of retatrutide.

news.title: The $30 trillion Treasury market is facing a painful reckoning. How rising yields could squeeze your portfolio.
news.summary: The roughly $30 trillion Treasury market is widely seen as the bedrock of the global financial system. It is facing a dangerous reckoning driven by a perfect storm of rising risks.
